description.value: Jackalope's is a neighbourhood dive bar and restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, built around a deliberately inclusive, no-frills ethos and an explicit anti-discrimination policy ('Be cool or get lost'). It serves regional cuisine in a relaxed, locals-first setting that makes no concessions to tourist expectations. A touring cyclist passing through East Van would find an unpretentious place to refuel rather than a hospitality-polished stop.
